To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.}} {{Dialogue Start}} {{WavesLine|text = :'''Unknown Sender:''' [Xianling Village Farmhouse] Grand Opening Special: half-price on everything! Be the first to taste our Waking Moon Feast. Even the Golden-Eyed One swears by it! Reply "Unsub" to unsubscribe. :{Choice} But I haven't tried it yet. ::'''(Rover):''' But I haven't tried it yet. ::'''Unknown Sender:''' Shoot, did this actually go to {{Rover}}'s Terminal...? :{Choice} Unsub. ::'''(Rover):''' Unsub. ::'''Unknown Sender:''' Don't go, valued patron! This text reaching you must be fate. Come give us a try! You won't regret it! ::{Choice} ? :'''(Rover):''' ? :'''Unknown Sender:''' [Auto-reply] We'd love to have you here!}} ---- ;Head to the tea stall in Xianling Village :'''Abby:''' Say, on this trip to the village, we're not having that same stuff again, are we? :'''{{Rover}}:''' ...Mengzhou Fish in Vinegar? :'''Abby:''' Eugh, yeah. Besides that, Xuanfang's full of good eats. Brocade Pearl Meatballs, Stir-Fried Trio, Jade Mushroom Soup... Slurrrp! Aww, now my tummy's rumbling again... :'''{{Rover}}:''' Abby, your appetite is always right on cue. :'''Abby:''' Heheh. C'mon, let's go grab a meal! ---- ;Talk to the tea stall owner :'''Tea Stall Owner:''' Come one, come all! You won't regret—Oh! {{Rover}}, is that you?! Welcome, welcome! :'''Tea Stall Owner:''' Our farmhouse restaurant is finally open for business! Here to sample the new menu? :{{DIcon}} Your spam ad blew up my Terminal... ::'''Tea Stall Owner:''' Wha—? Ah, well... haha, sorry about that! Today's meal is on us, so try anything you like! :{{DIcon}} I'm here for that Waking Moon Feast even the Golden-Eyed One swears by. ::'''Tea Stall Owner:''' Ha, you're a funny one! Ahaha... ::'''Tea Stall Owner:''' My honest apologies! We just thought it sounded catchier that way. Your meal today's on us, so try anything you like! :{{DIcon}} What would you recommend? ::'''Tea Stall Owner:''' That'd be our new Moon Fox Rice Cakes, no question. They're Lady Hsin's favorite treat! ---- ;Listen to the rumors at the tea stall :'''Hesitant Voice:''' So you're really set on moving to Mengzhou? :'''Hushed Voice:''' Of course! Once the Censure Courts clear out the last of the Tacet Discords, Xuanfang Hold will have served its purpose and collapse. We've known that since day one, haven't we? :'''Hesitant Voice:''' It can't just crumble overnight, though. The Ministry of War would give notice first, wouldn't they? :'''Hushed Voice:''' Oh, please... Think about all the strange things that've been happening. Sit around waiting for an official notice, and you'll be caught with your trousers down. :'''Hushed Voice:''' And with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs sending people now... something big's brewing. You can count on it... :'''Hushed Voice:''' Anyway, better to be ahead of the curve than buried under it. When things go sideways, who knows what else might happen... :'''Hesitant Voice:''' That's... kind of jumping at shadows, isn't it? :'''Hushed Voice:''' Ugh, you never see past your own nose. Forget it. Eat up, eat up. :'''{{Rover}}:''' (Xuanfang Hold collapsing... at a time like this? And the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs...) :'''{{Rover}}:''' (I remember their reach extends all across Huanglong... If they're showing up now, it must involve Hsin in some way.) :'''Tangning:''' (Oh... ran straight into {{MC|m=him|f=her}} the second I stepped out.) :'''Tangning:''' (Given my position, I really ought to speak with {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, but—) :'''Tangning:''' (Better see Intendant Suoming first. Safer to let her decide how to approach the Arbiter.) ---- ;Meet with Intendant Suoming :'''Tangning:''' (Last time I saw Intendant Suoming, I was still a fresh recruit.) :'''Tangning:''' (Ten years, gone in a blink...) ---- :'''Actor No. 1:''' Tangning? Well, look at you. All dressed up. ---- ;Talk to Shuyun :'''Shuyun:''' Tangning? Well, look at you. All dressed up. :'''Tangning:''' Dressed up? Feels like a plain old work uniform to me. :'''Shuyun:''' You? Work? I only ever see you loafing about the Hold, teasing birds, sipping tea, gabbing with anyone who listen. :'''Tangning:''' Ouch. You make me sound useless... even if you're not wrong. Anyway, I'm off. Gotta go see the boss. :'''Tangning:''' To be honest, I'm a little nervous. Heard she once ousted the local officials back home and took over herself... :'''Shuyun:''' Is this job of yours above board? Sounds like you work for a tyrant. :'''Tangning:''' I just worry we won't see eye to eye. That what matters to me... might mean nothing to her. :'''Shuyun:''' What's with the doom and gloom? You'll be fine, I know it. :'''Shuyun:''' Remember that rogue Autopuppet that smashed into my house? You took it down with a yawn while fixing your hair. :'''Tangning:''' I had no idea I was that good. And are you telling me to pick a fight with her...? :'''Shuyun:''' Haha. Tell you what, I just made some Moon Fox Rice Cakes. Bring them along as a gift for your scary boss. :'''Tangning:''' Oh... thank you. ---- ;Continue forward and meet with Suoming :'''Tangning:''' (I heard Intendant Suoming dislikes anything bitter-tasting. These rice cakes might just be...) ---- ;Talk to Yao :'''Yao:''' Tangning... :'''Tangning:''' Up and about already, Yao? :'''Yao:''' Mm. I'm much better now. :'''Tangning:''' Aw! You've been working hard, haven't you? For that, half these rice cakes are yours! :'''Tangning:''' Go easy on them, though. You just got better. :'''Yao:''' Thanks... Tangning, what's that thing on your waist? :'''Tangning:''' This? It's called the {{Extra Effect|Providence Lock|Providence Lock|A token Hsin the Moon Fox created for members of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. It protects, guides, and alerts anyone who carries it.}}. A gift from the Sentinel. :'''Yao:''' From the Sentinel? Really? :'''Tangning:''' Mm-hm. When I'm in trouble, it opens and helps me. Want it? :'''Yao:''' No thanks. Whenever I'm stuck, big brother Tangning always comes to help me. :'''Yao:''' You've helped me so, so many times already! :'''Tangning:''' Aww. You're too sweet, Yao. Now I feel like giving you all the rice cakes... :'''Tangning:''' But you're right! If you or anyone else might be in danger, I can't afford to freeze up. Not even in front of Intendant Suoming. :'''Yao:''' Mm... I don't really understand. But please don't get hurt, Tangning. :'''Tangning:''' Don't worry about me. Now hurry back inside and rest. It's chilly out here. Don't catch a chill. ---- :'''Actor No. 1:''' You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you. ---- {{WavesLine|text = :'''Qingxiao:''' {{Rover}}. My greetings have been remiss lately. :'''Qingxiao:''' Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_2 :'''Qingxiao:''' My new dwelling in the Xuanyuan Grotto-Heaven is newly raised. Sparrows sing from the eaves and the clouds drift in, a setting made for brewing tea and playing the qin. :'''Qingxiao:''' Should a free day find you, I would welcome you most gladly. :{Choice} Qingxiao? ::'''(Rover):''' Why so formal over comms again... :'''Qingxiao:''' An invitation calls for proper manners. That said, I've grown more adept with these messages. :'''Qingxiao:''' Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_8 :'''Qingxiao:''' ...In plainer words: if you're free, I'd like you to come sit a while at the Xuanyuan School's new training hall. :{Choice} New training hall? ::'''(Rover):''' New training hall? :'''Qingxiao:''' Yes, only just raised, with room enough for the disciples to practice the sword. :{Choice} That's my Master. Heading there now. ::'''(Rover):''' A whole new training hall already? That's my Master. :'''(Rover):''' Count me in for a visit, then. I'm available right now. :'''Qingxiao:''' Main_Mengzhou_3_7_15_16 :'''Qingxiao:''' Wonderful. ::Friend shared a location :'''Qingxiao:''' I'll be waiting here for you.}} ---- :'''Tangning:''' (Hm? Yao? What's she doing out here?) ---- ;Continue forward and meet with Suoming :'''Tangning:''' (First the Autopuppets going rogue, then the grim omen from the Providence Lock, and now the Intendant coming in person.) :'''Tangning:''' (No matter what happens to Xuanfang Hold... I will keep them safe, whatever it takes.) ---- ;Talk to Jiqing :'''Jiqing:''' You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you. :'''Jiqing:''' I am Jiqing. Thank you for your service. Ten years in the Hold is no small thing. :'''Tangning:''' It's nothing. But may I ask, do you have any insight into what she might be thinking? :'''Jiqing:''' What she's thinking? Meaning? :'''Tangning:''' I don't doubt the Intendant's competence. I'm sure she can handle whatever comes. :'''Tangning:''' But... she doesn't feel for Xuanfang Hold the way I do. And those rumors about her, two hundred years back... :'''Tangning:''' I'm afraid she'll sacrifice the Hold's best interests for the Ministry's ends. :'''Jiqing:''' Seems you're not very familiar with those rumors, or else I doubt you'd think that. :'''Tangning:''' I know that everyone who fought beside her back then were all— :'''Jiqing:''' Easy now. Speak with Intendant Suoming yourself. If you have concerns, voice them directly. ---- ;Meet with Intendant Suoming :'''Tangning:''' (If the Intendant truly means to leave the Hold to its fate, then I'll have to...) ---- ;Suoming meets with Tangning :'''Tangning:''' Intendant Suoming. :'''Suoming:''' Yes. Speak. :'''Tangning:''' Not long ago, my Providence Lock opened on its own. Following its guidance, I went in secret to the Manifold Sanctum and measured the Sentinel's frequency. :'''Tangning:''' There's no mistaking it. Her frequency is fading fast. I fear the Sanctum could fall at any moment. :'''Suoming:''' I see. Your years of reporting to the Ministry on all that has occurred here are duly noted. :'''Suoming:''' All of it, exactly as you foresaw a century ago. :
[[File:Simulacrum of the Heart CG Sentinel Hsin's Last Moment.png|500px]]
:'''Suoming:''' I understand your final charge. I will deliver it into "Hsin's" hands. :'''???:''' Forgive me. In the end, the promise went unkept. :'''Suoming:''' No matter. From the day we met, I have known you gave everything you had. :'''Suoming:''' And the promise is only deferred. A hundred years is nothing. Without you in Mengzhou, the Ministry will have much to do. :'''???:''' Then it all falls to you, Suoming. :'''Suoming:''' You needn't say that. This was all part of your design, wasn't it? :'''???:''' Not design. Only faith. Faith in you... and in Her. :'''Suoming:''' Today's the day, then... :'''Suoming:''' The Manifold Sanctum and Hsin the Moon Fox are one and the same. I must see the truth for myself before it falls. :'''Suoming:''' Only the three of us will go, lest we rouse the "snake." We should not draw attention. :'''Tangning:''' But— :'''Suoming:''' Tangning. I know this place holds your heart. Your concern is only natural. :'''Suoming:''' Hsin the Moon Fox accounted for this from the start. The Sanctum was built to break clean from the Hold. :'''Suoming:''' Should the worst happen and it falls, the surrounding districts will remain standing. :'''Suoming:''' And should the Hold itself be imperiled, don't look for me. Put the people first. :'''Tangning:''' I, Tangning, will see that it is done. :'''Suoming:''' One more thing. Ten years you've held this post. With Hsin here, I should've been the one overseeing Xuanfang myself. :'''Suoming:''' But Mengzhou's crises didn't let me go. You and your predecessors have held firm in your duty. :'''Suoming:''' For Hsin, for Mengzhou, you've done more than your share. You have my gratitude. :'''Tangning:''' Yes! Intendant Suoming, may all be well in {{Rubi|Hsin's|heart}} keeping. :'''Suoming:''' May all be well in Hsin's keeping. :'''Tangning:''' Ah, that reminds me. Xuanfang's Waking Moon Festival is almost here. The last few were a delight. Will you join us this time, Intendant? :'''Suoming:''' The Waking Moon Festival... If things go well, we'll see. ---- ;Head to the "new training hall" :'''Abby:''' How'd she put up a whole new training hall so fast? :'''{{Rover}}:''' It's Qingxiao, after all. She's probably got some secret art for it. :'''{{Rover}}:''' We'll know once we get there. If it's her hall... :'''Abby:''' Oh! I can kind of picture it. Bet it's one of those misty, immortal-looking places, huh? ---- ;Meet with Qingxiao :'''Girl:''' Take this! Xuanyuan First Form, Hidden Heart! :'''Boy:''' Master Qingxiao never taught us that move... Cheater! :'''Girl:''' The immortal lady told us, "We train in the heart, not in the form." I came up with this myself! :'''Qingxiao:''' {{Rover}}, you've come. :'''Children:''' Greetings, Senior {{MC|m=Brother|f=Sister}}! :{{DIcon}} Taking in disciples already, Master Sword Transcendent? ::'''Qingxiao:''' ...Mm. In the old days, if I did not attend, Hsin would send a Rafter Kite to fetch me, hounding me till I went. :'''Boy:''' I wish we could meet Lady Hsin! Grandma and Grandpa always say the Sentinel will come to play with us at the festival, but we've never seen Her, not once. :'''Girl:''' Don't you know? That's just grown-up talk to make us behave. Like the one about Autopuppets stealing kids who won't go to bed... :'''Qingxiao:''' Hsin is... simply a little busy. You will have the chance to see Her some other day. :'''Qingxiao:''' Your mother's here. Off you go. :{{DIcon}} Everything all right? :'''Qingxiao:''' It's just... I'm still not quite used to minding such lively little ones. :'''{{Rover}}:''' Does it remind you of when you first met Ruoyun? :'''Qingxiao:''' No... Hsin. :'''{{Rover}}:''' ...? :'''Qingxiao:''' But let's return to the matter at hand. :'''Qingxiao:''' I asked you here, in part, to talk about Hsin. These past few days... the presence I have sensed from Her has grown weaker than before. :'''Qingxiao:''' Hsin keeps no set path, so a flickering presence is nothing new... She vanishes for a time, then reappears as if nothing happened, chattering of trifles. :'''Qingxiao:''' In the past, Hsin never spoke of what She was doing, so I asked no further. :'''Qingxiao:''' Yet with Xuanfang's portents growing more frequent, even the Rafter Kites no longer bring word of Her. Until moments ago, I sensed a wisp of Her presence near the Sanctum, but it was gone in a breath, too fleeting to catch. :'''Qingxiao:''' ...Hence my wish for you to accompany me to Xuanfang Hold to search for Her trail. And when the moment calls, I may need to rely on your power as Arbiter. :{{DIcon}} I understand. :'''{{Rover}}:''' Then let's head to the Hold first. There's something I've been wanting to look into as well. :'''{{Rover}}:''' Talk on the way? :'''Qingxiao:''' Thank you. After all this is settled... :{{DIcon}} You'll invite me to dinner? :{{DIcon}} You'll take me to the Waking Moon Festival? :'''Qingxiao:''' ...So be it. ---- :'''Actor No. 1:''' The two of them are going at it again... Someone find a Warden, quickly... ---- ;Investigate the source of the rumors :'''Wanhong:''' I'm not leaving. After everything we've been through, you want me to listen to some stranger?! :'''Qingchen:''' This is about keeping us safe... Won't you stop being so stubborn...!? :'''Qingchen:''' Ah, Paragon Qingxiao, {{Rover}}! Thank goodness you're here. Help me talk some sense into my father, please... :{{DIcon}} What's all this about? ::'''Qingchen:''' Well, a while back, someone from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs said the Hold had "served its purpose" and would collapse any day now. Told us to move out while we could. ::'''Wanhong:''' Ridiculous. Our family has lived in this land for generations. You don't just pack up and leave... ::'''Qingchen:''' To be fair, I'm not convinced either. It came out of nowhere... ::'''Qingchen:''' But that person carried an Intendant's command token. Clearly no small figure... And I'd rather not wait to find out. We can't survive another disaster like the Autopuppet rebellion... ::{{DIcon}} Nothing's settled yet. No need to panic. :::'''Qingchen:''' If you say so, {{Rover}}, I want to believe it. But the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... ::{{DIcon}} Something does feel off... :::'''Qingchen:''' See? Even {{Rover}} thinks the same thing! ::'''Liangyu:''' Paragon Qingxiao, my apologies for disturbing your cultivation. But there's been an emergency... It requires your attention. ::'''Qingxiao:''' It's no trouble. What's happened? ::'''Liangyu:''' Someone tried to break into the Sanctum. We've detained her, but she claims to hold the Sentinel's token. Except... it's not in any of our records. No way to verify it. ::'''Qingxiao:''' Token... ::'''Qingxiao:''' Did she say where she came from? ::'''Liangyu:''' She said... she's an Intendant in Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. ::'''Qingxiao:''' ...I see. {{Rover}} and I are bound for the Sanctum as we speak. We won't be long. ---- :'''Actor No. 1:''' Well? Still have reservations about Intendant Suoming? :'''Actor No. 2:''' Not anymore. But one thing still bothers me... ---- ;Talk to the stranger in black :'''Jiqing:''' Well? Still have reservations about Intendant Suoming? :'''Tangning:''' Not anymore. But... one thing still bothers me. :'''Tangning:''' What happened before she joined the Ministry. The way she took the frequencies of her fallen comrades... :'''Jiqing:''' Hm. The omens of the Sanctum's fall aren't settled yet. Let's get through this first. I'll explain later. :'''Jiqing:''' What worries me more right now is the people. Our presence here has already— :'''Tangning:''' Shh. Leave it for now. :{{DIcon}} The Sanctum's fall? What are you two talking about? ::'''{{Rover}}:''' Are you the ones spreading rumors and causing all this panic? ::'''Qingxiao:''' That uniform... they're from Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. ::'''Jiqing:''' You must be... the Xuan Paragon of Xuanfang Hold, and this {{MC|m=gentleman|f=lady}}... Never mind. ::'''Qingxiao:''' Why the evasion? ::'''Tangning:''' Forgive us. To us in the Ministry, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} holds a special standing. Not something to speak of before outsiders. ::'''{{Rover}}:''' Your Ministry governs Sentinel matters, so this is about... ::'''{{Rover}}:''' Ah, I get it. Qingxiao already knows I'm the Arbiter. No need to dance around it. ::'''Tangning:''' We meant no disrespect, Arbiter. The situation demanded immediate action. We couldn't report in time. ::'''Tangning:''' Besides, the Intendant ordered us to stay silent. She said... you would surely arrive at the Sanctum at this time, and that all your questions would be answered there. ::'''Jiqing:''' As for the panic this has caused, we'll help the Wardens contain it. ::'''{{Rover}}:''' ...I see. I understand your position. I won't make things more difficult. ::'''{{Rover}}:''' But when this is all over, I want the full story. ::'''Jiqing:''' You have my word, Arbiter.
